name: Rosie the Mini Pig
description: A charming teacup mini pig with a rosy snout. Perfect family companion.
details: Rosie is a healthy, vaccinated 8-week-old mini pig. She loves belly rubs, fruit treats, and exploring the yard. Weight at maturity: ~25 lbs. Comes with starter feed and care guide.

name: Sir Oinksalot
description: A distinguished mini pig gentleman with a noble demeanor and curious eyes.
details: Sir Oinksalot is 10 weeks old, litter-trained, and socialized with children and other pets. Weight at maturity: ~30 lbs. Includes harness and leash for outdoor walks.

name: Hamlet the Heritage Pig
description: Classic heritage breed farm pig. Robust, friendly, and great for small farms.
details: Hamlet is a Berkshire heritage breed, 12 weeks old. Excellent forager and pasture pig. Great temperament for small-scale homesteaders. Weight at maturity: ~250 lbs.

name: Peppa the Spotted Pig
description: Adorable spotted Gloucestershire Old Spot piglet. A living piece of farm history.
details: Peppa is a purebred Gloucestershire Old Spot, a rare heritage breed with distinctive black spots. 14 weeks old, weaned, and ready for farm life. Comes with pedigree certificate.

name: Truffle the Truffle Hunter
description: A specially trained mini pig with an exceptional nose for truffles and treats.
details: Truffle has been gently scent-trained from birth. She responds to basic commands, walks on a leash, and is exceptionally food-motivated — perfect for truffle hunting as a hobby. Weight at maturity: ~22 lbs.

name: Wilbur the Woolly Pig
description: A Mangalica 'woolly' pig with a unique curly coat. The pig world's rarest beauty.
details: Wilbur is a purebred Mangalica, the only pig breed with a woolly fleece-like coat. This 16-week-old boar is tame, vaccinated, and dewormed. Weight at maturity: ~180 lbs. Includes registration papers.

name: Cinnamon the KuneKune
description: A friendly KuneKune pig from New Zealand, known for its gentle grazing nature.
details: Cinnamon is a KuneKune piglet, a breed famous for being grass-fed and ultra-docile. 9 weeks old. Ideal for families and small paddocks. Weight at maturity: ~100–200 lbs. Includes diet plan and vet records.

name: Baxter the Berkshire
description: A classic black Berkshire pig, prized for premium quality meat and docile nature.
details: Baxter is a registered Berkshire pig, 10 weeks old. This breed is renowned by chefs worldwide for its marbled, flavourful meat. He is fully vaccinated and comes with lineage documentation.
